record.paper_title: Nicholson's blowflies differential equations revisited: Main results and open problems
record.original_question: Study Nicholson-type blowflies equations with linear impulsive perturbations x(t_k+) = a_k x(t_k) at fixed impulse times t_k when the underlying delay is variable or distributed rather than constant. Determine existence of global positive solutions, permanence, stability, and oscillation for these impulsive variable-delay or distributed-delay models. In addition, assuming the positive equilibrium of the corresponding non-impulsive Nicholson equation is globally asymptotically stable, find sufficient conditions on the impulse multipliers a_k under which the zero solution of the impulsive equation is globally asymptotically stable, equivalently giving a termination-rate criterion that eventually drives the pest population to extinction.

evidence.quote: We propose to study the impulsive model with variable (generally, distributed) delay: existence of global positive solutions, permanence, stability and oscillation.
Find sufficient conditions on ak such that the zero solution of the impulsive equation is globally asymptotically stable.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the impulsive Nicholson-type blowflies delay differential equation
  x'(t) = -δ(t) x(t) + Σ_{j=1}^m p_j(t) x(t-τ_j(t)) exp(-x(t-τ_j(t))),   t ≠ t_k,
  x(t_k^+) = a_k x(t_k),                                                 k = 1,2,...,
with prescribed continuous, positive coefficients δ(t), p_j(t), continuous variable delays τ_j(t) ≥ 0, an unbounded increasing sequence of impulse times 0 < t_1 < t_2 < ... → ∞, and impulse multipliers a_k > 0. Allow also the distributed-delay version
  x'(t) = -δ(t) x(t) + ∫_0^∞ K(t,s) x(t-s) exp(-x(t-s)) ds,   t ≠ t_k,
with the same impulse rule x(t_k^+) = a_k x(t_k), where K is a nonnegative kernel.

(a) Establish existence of global positive solutions, permanence (uniform persistence and ultimate boundedness), stability of positive equilibria/solutions, and oscillation criteria for these impulsive variable-delay and distributed-delay Nicholson models.

(b) Assume that, in the absence of impulses (i.e. with all a_k = 1), the corresponding non-impulsive equation has a positive equilibrium that is globally asymptotically stable on the space of positive continuous initial functions. Find explicit sufficient conditions on the sequence {a_k} (e.g. on the asymptotic behavior of the products Π_{k} a_k or on a "termination rate" lim sup_{t→∞} (1/t) Σ_{t_k ≤ t} ln a_k) under which the zero solution of the impulsive equation is globally asymptotically stable; equivalently, give a criterion ensuring that every positive solution tends to 0 as t → ∞.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature contains many partial results on impulsive Nicholson blowflies equations with constant or time-varying delays (existence of positive periodic solutions, permanence, attractivity), and separate results on non-impulsive variable/distributed-delay Nicholson equations. However, no single source clearly settles the full program of existence, permanence, stability and oscillation for the impulsive variable/distributed-delay model together with sharp sufficient conditions on the impulse multipliers a_k driving solutions to zero. The status is best described as partially addressed but not definitively resolved.

status_evidence.title: Existence and global attractivity of positive periodic solutions for the impulsive delay Nicholson's blowflies model
status_evidence.snippet: Studies impulsive delay Nicholson model and gives attractivity of positive periodic solutions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on impulsive Nicholson models exists, but for periodic positive solutions rather than the full open program.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of the diffusive Nicholson's blowflies equation with distributed delay
status_evidence.snippet: Distributed-delay Nicholson dynamics studied without impulses.
status_evidence.claim: Distributed-delay non-impulsive case is studied separately, indicating the impulsive distributed-delay problem remains comparatively unaddressed.

status_evidence.title: New results on global asymptotic stability for a nonlinear density-dependent mortality Nicholson's blowflies model with multiple pairs of time-varying delays
status_evidence.snippet: Global asymptotic stability with time-varying delays without impulses.
status_evidence.claim: Variable-delay non-impulsive case has stability criteria, but impulsive analogue with extinction criteria on a_k is not established here.
